attchmntText: Steamhouse India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 29, 2026, titled "Press release on the financial performance of the Company for the quarter ended 30th September 2026.".

Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Regulation 33 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended ("SEBI Listing Regulations"), we hereby inform you that the Board of Directors ("Board") of Steamhouse India Limited ("Company"), at its meeting held today, i.e., October 29, 2026, has considered and approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
Steamhouse India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Steamhouse India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 27, 2026, titled "Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015   Press Release regarding signing of a Memorandum of Understanding with Haryana Enterprises Promotion Centre (HEPC), Government of Haryana".

Steamhouse India Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meetPursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended from time to time, read with Para A of Schedule III thereto, We wish to inform you that the Company has arranged Earnings Call with Investor/Analyst (Participants) to discuss the Financial Results of the Company for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026, scheduled on Friday, October 30, 2026, at 1:00 P.M. IST. The Earnings Call invite is enclosed for your records.

Steamhouse India Limited has informed the Exchange about Cancellation of Scheduled Investors & Analysts Plant VisitThis is with reference to our letter dated 15th October 2026, we would like to inform you that the Investors & Analysts Plant Visit scheduled on 23rd October 2026, has been cancelled due to some exigencies.This is for your information and for the information of your members and the public at large.This information is submitted to you pursuant to Regulation 30 (6) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015.Kindly take the above information on record.
